claim: Hunter Biden, son of US President Joe Biden has died.
justification: The high-confidence evidence from both fact-checks consistently indicates that Hunter Biden is alive, with multiple corroborated statements (e.g., confidence 0.95 items) showing that the death claim on October 25, 2020, was a debunked hoax from unreliable sources. Specifically, evidence confirms Hunter Biden's public and legal activities after the claim date, such as involvement in the 2020 campaign and legal proceedings in 2023, contradicting the claim of his death. Low-confidence items supporting the claim are contradicted and lack credibility, so they are discounted in favor of the trustworthy, high-confidence evidence.
